design_name: EXP-07 Controlled Scientific Diagnostic Experiment Specification

two_tier_architecture.tier_1_zero_compute_cross_inference: Evaluate existing historical checkpoints across datasets without any retraining (0 cloud cost, 0 training risk).
two_tier_architecture.tier_2_single_variable_controlled_traini: If Tier 1 proves insufficient, execute a single-variable controlled training experiment to isolate loss weighting from dataset distribution shift.

tier_1_cross_evaluation_specification.objective: Disentangle whether OPS-02 DEV is universally out-of-distribution for any Sentinel-1 model vs whether C16 suffered an optimization defect.

protocol.step_1: Load historical C8/C10 model weights (trained on OPS-01) and run read-only inference on the 40 frozen OPS-02 DEV samples.
protocol.step_2: Load C16 best_model.pt (trained on OPS-02) and run read-only inference on historical OPS-01 DEV samples.
protocol.step_3: Compute 12-class confusion matrix, per-class IoU, and macro phenomena mIoU for both.

interpretation_criteria.supports_distribution_shift: If C8/C10 model also achieves < 10% on OPS-02 DEV, the collapse is conclusively driven by out-of-distribution parent cluster diversity (H1/H2).
interpretation_criteria.supports_c16_training_defect: If C8/C10 model achieves > 25% on OPS-02 DEV, C16 optimization or loss weighting suffered a specific defect (H7).

tier_2_controlled_training_specification.research_question: Does square-root median-frequency weighting (with 18.2x weight on HM) cause background seawater under-prediction and overall mIoU collapse compared to unweighted/moderated loss?

variables.independent_variable: Loss weighting scheme: Control (C16 Sqrt-Median Weights) vs Treatment (Uniform Unweighted CrossEntropyLoss w_c = 1.0)
constant_variables: Model: ResNet18-UNet (14,310,860 parameters, ImageNet pretrained encoder)
Sampler: Candidate F Hybrid (70% parent, 30% presence, 72 draws/epoch)

success_and_failure_criteria.loss_weighting_causality_supported: Treatment achieves Background IoU > 0.30 (vs 0.026) and overall phenomena mIoU > 0.08.
success_and_failure_criteria.loss_weighting_causality_falsified: Treatment shows identical background collapse (BG IoU < 0.05) and phenomena mIoU <= 0.05.

tier_2_controlled_training_specification.execution_gate: DO NOT EXECUTE IN C18. Requires explicit user review and authorization under Phase 15.
